requirements.item_text: Reports of investigations or evaluations for complaints, supplier qualification, periodic record and data reviews and failure investigations are available for regulatory inspection and kept for at least the retention period set by GMP rules.

mappings.quote: Such records are subject to FDA inspection and must be retained for at least the time specified in the CGMP regulations (see § 211.180).
Such records are subject to FDA inspection and must be retained for at least the time specified in the CGMP regulations (see § 211.180).

requirements.item_text: Operations are clearly described in written procedures.

mappings.quote: operations are clearly specified in written procedures
operations are clearly specified in written procedures

Standard operating procedures and associated records should be available for at least the following: ■ equipment ■ analytical apparatus and instruments ■ out-of-specification results ■ maintenance and calibration ■ cleaning and sanitization ■ personnel matters, such as training, clothing and hygiene ■ qualification and validation ■ self-inspection and audits ■ complaints ■ recalls ■ returns.
mappings.addendum: Written procedures with associated records exist at least for: equipment and analytical instruments; maintenance and calibration; cleaning and sanitisation; results outside specification; staff training, hygiene and clothing; qualification and validation; self-inspections and audits; complaints, recalls and returns.

mappings.quote: operations and other activities are clearly described in a written form, such as standard operating procedures and work instructions

requirements.item_text: Data may also be recorded by other means in parallel with the computerised system.

mappings.quote: Data may be recorded by other means in addition to the computer system.
Data may be recorded by other means in addition to the computer system.

requirements.item_text: The licensee has prepared a concise site master file with specific, factual GMP information on the production and/or control of the pharmaceutical products made at the licensed site.

mappings.quote: The licensee shall prepare a succinct document in the form of ‘Site Master File’ containing specific and factual Good Manufacturing Practices about the production or control or both of pharmaceutical manufacturing preparations carried out at the licensed premises.

The licensee shall prepare a succinct document in the form of ‘Site Master File’ containing specific and factual Good Manufacturing Practices about the production or control or both of pharmaceutical manufacturing preparations carried out at the licensed premises.

requirements.item_text: The site master file includes general information: a brief company profile; the manufacturing activities authorised by the licensing authority; any other manufacturing done on the premises; the licensed product types with process flow charts; staff numbers in production, quality control, storage and distribution; any external scientific, analytical or technical support used for manufacture and analysis; products registered abroad; and brief outlines of the quality management system, the pharmaceutical quality system and quality risk assessment.

mappings.quote: General information:- (a) brief information of the firm; (b) pharmaceutical manufacturing activities as permitted by the licensing authority; (c) other manufacturing activities, if any, carried out in the premises; (d) type of products licensed for manufacture with flow charts mentioning procedure and process flow; (e) number of employees engaged in the production, quality control, storage and distribution; (f) use of outside scientific, analytical or other technical assistance in relation to manufacture and analysis; (g) products details registered with foreign countries. (h) short description of the Quality Management System of the firm; (i) pharmaceutical Quality System; and (j) quality risk assessment.

General information:- (a) brief information of the firm; (b) pharmaceutical manufacturing activities as permitted by the licensing authority; (c) other manufacturing activities, if any, carried out in the premises; (d) type of products licensed for manufacture with flow charts mentioning procedure and process flow; (e) number of employees engaged in the production, quality control, storage and distribution; (f) use of outside scientific, analytical or other technical assistance in relation to manufacture and analysis; (g) products details registered with foreign countries. (h) short description of the Quality Management System of the firm; (i) pharmaceutical Quality System; and (j) quality risk assessment.

requirements.item_text: The site master file includes a personnel section: an organisation chart showing how quality assurance, production and quality control are arranged; the qualifications, experience and responsibilities of key staff; an outline of initial and ongoing training and how training records are kept; health requirements for production staff; and hygiene and clothing requirements.

mappings.quote: Personnel:- (a) organisational chart showing the arrangement for quality assurance including production and quality control; (b) qualifications, experience and responsibilities of key personnel; (c) outline for arrangements for basic and in-service training and how the records are maintained; (d) health requirements for personnel engaged in production; and (e) personnel hygiene requirements, including clothing.

Personnel:- (a) organisational chart showing the arrangement for quality assurance including production and quality control; (b) qualifications, experience and responsibilities of key personnel; (c) outline for arrangements for basic and in-service training and how the records are maintained; (d) health requirements for personnel engaged in production; and (e) personnel hygiene requirements, including clothing.

requirements.item_text: The site master file includes a premises section: a scaled plan or description of the manufacturing areas, the type of construction and the fixtures and fittings, and a brief description of the ventilation systems.

mappings.quote: Premises:- (a) simple plan or description of manufacturing areas drawn to scale; (b) nature of construction and fixtures or fittings; (c) brief description of ventilation systems.
Premises:- (a) simple plan or description of manufacturing areas drawn to scale; (b) nature of construction and fixtures or fittings; (c) brief description of ventilation systems.

requirements.item_text: For critical areas where airborne contamination is a potential risk, the site master file describes ventilation in greater detail, including schematic drawings of the systems.

mappings.quote: More details shall be given for critical areas with potential risk of airborne contamination (schematic drawing of systems).
More details shall be given for critical areas with potential risk of airborne contamination (schematic drawing of systems).

requirements.item_text: The site master file states the cleanroom classification of each room used to make sterile products.

mappings.quote: Classification of the rooms used for the manufacture of sterile products shall be mentioned
Classification of the rooms used for the manufacture of sterile products shall be mentioned

requirements.item_text: The site master file also describes any special areas for handling highly toxic, hazardous or sensitising materials, gives a brief description of the water system with schematic drawings and its sanitisation, and describes the planned preventive maintenance programme for the premises and how it is recorded.

mappings.quote: special areas for the handling of the highly toxic, hazardous and sensitising materials; (e) brief description of water system (schematic drawings of systems), including sanitation; and (f) description of planned preventive maintenance programmes for premises and of the recording system.

special areas for the handling of the highly toxic, hazardous and sensitising materials; (e) brief description of water system (schematic drawings of systems), including sanitation; and (f) description of planned preventive maintenance programmes for premises and of the recording system.

requirements.item_text: The site master file includes an equipment section: a brief description and list of the major production and quality control laboratory equipment; the planned preventive maintenance programme for equipment and how it is recorded; and qualification and calibration, including how they are recorded and how computerised systems are validated.

mappings.quote: Equipment:- (a) brief description of major equipment used in production and Quality Control Laboratories (a list of equipment required); (b) description of planned preventive maintenance programmes for equipment and of the recording system; and (c) qualification and calibration including the recording systems and arrangements for computerised systems validation.

Equipment:- (a) brief description of major equipment used in production and Quality Control Laboratories (a list of equipment required); (b) description of planned preventive maintenance programmes for equipment and of the recording system; and (c) qualification and calibration including the recording systems and arrangements for computerised systems validation.

requirements.item_text: The site master file includes a sanitation section showing that written specifications and procedures are in place for cleaning manufacturing areas and equipment.

mappings.quote: Sanitation:-availability of written specifications and procedures for cleaning manufacturing areas and equipment.
Sanitation:-availability of written specifications and procedures for cleaning manufacturing areas and equipment.

requirements.item_text: The site master file includes a documentation section: how documents are prepared, revised and distributed; the documents needed for manufacture; and any other product-quality documents not described elsewhere, such as microbiological controls of air and water.

mappings.quote: Documentation:- (a) arrangements for the preparation, revision and distribution of; (b) necessary documentation for the manufacture; and (c) any other documentation related to product quality that is not mentioned elsewhere (e.g., microbiological controls about air and water).

Documentation:- (a) arrangements for the preparation, revision and distribution of; (b) necessary documentation for the manufacture; and (c) any other documentation related to product quality that is not mentioned elsewhere (e.g., microbiological controls about air and water).

requirements.item_text: The site master file includes a production section: a brief description of production operations, using flow sheets and charts with key parameters wherever possible; how starting materials, packaging materials, bulk and finished products are handled, including sampling, quarantine, release and storage; how rejected materials and products are handled; and a brief outline of the general process validation policy.

mappings.quote: Production:- (a) brief description of production operations using, wherever possible, flow sheets and charts specifying important parameters; (b)arrangements for the handling of starting materials, packaging materials, bulk and finished products, including sampling, quarantine, release and storage; (c) arrangements for the handling of rejected materials and products; and (d)brief description of general policy for process validation.

Production:- (a) brief description of production operations using, wherever possible, flow sheets and charts specifying important parameters; (b) arrangements for the handling of starting materials, packaging materials, bulk and finished products, including sampling, quarantine, release and storage; (c) arrangements for the handling of rejected materials and products; and (d) brief description of general policy for process validation.

requirements.item_text: The site master file includes a quality assurance and control section covering the documentation system, change control, the validation master plan and validation policy, product quality review, a description of the quality control system and the work of the quality control department, and the procedures for releasing finished products.

mappings.quote: Quality Assurance and Control:- (a) documentation system; (b) change control; (c) master validation plan and validation policy; (d) product quality review; and (e) description of the quality control system and of the activities of the QC Department. Procedures for the release of the finished products.

Quality Assurance and Control:- (a) documentation system; (b) change control; (c) master validation plan and validation policy; (d) product quality review; and (e) description of the quality control system and of the activities of the QC Department. Procedures for the release of the finished products.

requirements.item_text: Where products are made under a loan licence, the site master file describes how the loan licensee's compliance with GMP will be assessed.

mappings.quote: Manufacture under loan licence and licensee:- description of the way in which compliance of GMP by the loan licensee shall be assessed.
Manufacture under loan licence and licensee:- description of the way in which compliance of GMP by the loan licensee shall be assessed.

requirements.item_text: The site master file describes the arrangements and recording system for distribution, and the arrangements for handling complaints and product recalls.

mappings.quote: Distribution, complaints and product recall:- (a) arrangements and recording system for distribution; and (b)arrangements for the handling of complaints and product recalls.
Distribution, complaints and product recall:- (a) arrangements and recording system for distribution; and (b) arrangements for the handling of complaints and product recalls.

requirements.item_text: The site master file briefly describes the self-inspection system and states whether an independent, experienced outside expert took part in assessing the manufacturer's GMP compliance across all aspects of production.

mappings.quote: Self-inspection:- short description of the self-inspection system indicating whether an outside, independent and experienced external expert was involved in evaluating the manufacturer’s compliance with GMP in all aspects of production.

Self-inspection:- short description of the self-inspection system indicating whether an outside, independent and experienced external expert was involved in evaluating the manufacturer’s compliance with GMP in all aspects of production.

requirements.item_text: The site master file lists the products exported to each country and any complaints and product recalls related to them.

mappings.quote: Export of drugs:- (a) products exported to different countries; and (b) complaints and product recall, if any.
Export of drugs:- (a) products exported to different countries; and (b) complaints and product recall, if any.
